title: Privacy by Design Architecture
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Organizational Analytics
description: Layered architecture diagram showing twelve privacy controls across the Data Collection, Storage, Analysis, and Reporting layers of an organizational analytics system. Includes hover explanations, collapsible layers, and a scoring mode that reports a score for each layer and names the weakest one.

learningObjectives: Assess whether an organizational analytics architecture incorporates adequate privacy-by-design principles at each layer

controls.label: Score Your System
controls.description: Show a check box on every control and a score for each layer

controls.label: Start from
controls.description: Load a blank checklist or a sample system to assess

controls.label: Layer headers and control boxes
controls.description: Click a header to collapse a layer; click a control to pin its explanation or toggle its check box

keyQuestions: Which layer of this system is weakest?
Can strong controls in one layer make up for none in another?
Which missing control should be added first?
commonMisconceptions: Encryption alone makes an analytics system private
A high total score means every layer is protected
assessmentOpportunities: Score a described system layer by layer
Justify a go or no-go recommendation from the missing controls
